basic_info.description: Prime Inner Sunset Triplex - Exceptional Opportunity in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. Modern with a timeless 1967 charm, featuring three bright and airy units, each offering generous living space. Units 1 & 2: Charming 1-bedroom, 1-bath residences on the main level.    Unit 3: Expansive full-floor upper unit featuring 3 bedrooms and 2 baths.    Bonus & vacant: 2 rooms & a full bath on the lower level with a private deck - ideal for office or exercise room.    Parking: Rare 2-car side-by-side garage.    Private rear yard with concrete patio, perfect for gatherings and barbecues.    Modernized kitchens and bathrooms throughout.    Steps to the vibrant 9th Avenue dining corridor, Golden Gate Park, and UCSF Medical Center.Rental Income:    Unit #1 - $2,740 (month-to-month)    Unit #2 - $1,550 (month-to-month, tenant has given notice)    Unit #3 - $3,003 (month-to-month)    Bonus Space - Vacant
